$comment: Hand-kept names and colours for the Constellation's regions (scripts/influence/build-constellation.mjs). The builder matches each region to an entry by its five largest shown keywords: 3+ shared keeps the name, 2 keeps it with a warning, fewer means no match, and the builder proposes a name and warns. It never renames anything silently. Colours: the four the design paints (land use #1baf7a, heat #eb6834, remote-sensing #0d366b, air #d55181) plus #2a78d6 from the same documented palette. First named 2026-10-10 from that run's top keywords; Ken to review.

regions.zh: 城市生物多样性与绿地
